requestedIntent: Document a domain-agnostic product risk model for finding business, edge-case, and abuse risks before development.
limitations: No ACEF workflow, actor, review lens, schema, validator, installer, or target-repo integration enforces this method yet.
One retroactive backtest (delta3-pm gift-membership, 2026-07-06) shows shape fit only: it was run after the miss was known, so it does not prove independent predictive power.
One live pass (delta3-pm campaign-code) produced dispositioned findings with file:line evidence, but on already-shipped code, not pre-development.
Promotion beyond documented-only requires a blind pre-implementation run whose findings are compared against later implementation/review findings.
Domain adapters are expected to extend the core method; they are not part of this ACEF capability record.

evidence.note: External domain adapter consuming this method; draft, not yet wired into delta3-pm prompts.
